categories.main_business_segments: Sokan New Materials Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of new functional coating materials including coatings, inks, and adhesives. Its main application markets are high-end consumer electronics, passenger vehicles, and special equipment sectors such as aerospace and rail transit. The company offers system solutions for functional coatings tailored to various substrates and curing methods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as UV curing, thermal curing, PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition), NCVM (Non-Conductive Vacuum Metallization), and digital inkjet printing for insulation coatings. It employs a 'customized flexible manufacturing' model supported by automated production systems and integrates R&D with production to innovate in materials like silicone tactile coatings, waterborne coatings, and high-performance automotive PVD coatings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic leading brands in consumer electronics (e.g., Microsoft, Google, HP, Amazon, Meta, Xiaomi, OPPO, VIVO) and automotive manufacturers and suppliers (e.g., BYD, NIO, Geely, Li Auto, Huawei, North American T company). The company serves end markets such as smartphones, laptops, wearable devices, smart home appliances, passenger car interiors and exteriors, and strategic emerging industries like new energy batteries and aerospace.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hunan Province and production and R&D facilities across multiple Chinese cities. It has established overseas subsidiaries and production bases in Vietnam, India, the United States, and Hong Kong to serve Southeast Asia, North America, and other international markets, supporting a global marketing and service network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sokan New Materials is positioned upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a producer of functional coating materials and system solutions. It supplies coatings, inks, and adhesives directly to mold factories and indirectly to terminal customers (brands) in consumer electronics and automotive sectors, integrating closely with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership and innovation with significant R&D investment (~14% of revenue). Strategic R&D focuses include advanced coating materials (e.g., UV insulation inks, PVD coatings), digital printing technologies, environmentally friendly waterborne coatings, and system solutions integrating materials, equipment, and processes. It actively pursues breakthroughs in new energy vehicle coatings, AI-enabled applications, and emerging industries like aerospace and low-altitude economy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of coatings, inks, and adhesives to industrial customers in consumer electronics, automotive, and special equipment sectors. The company also derives income from customized system solutions, technical services, and strategic investments in related upstream and downstream enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sokan New Materials competes with international chemical giants such as AkzoNobel, PPG, BASF, and Nippon Paint in the functional coatings market. It is recognized as a leading domestic player capable of competing directly with global brands and achieving product localization and substitution, especially in high-end consumer electronics and automotive coatings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 745.5 million, a 26.4% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 86.4 million, up 6.5%. Total assets grew nearly 15% to RMB 1.81 billion. The company maintains steady growth with expanding R&D investment and increasing market penetration domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sokan New Materials differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, a comprehensive product portfolio covering coatings, inks, and adhesives, and integrated system solutions tailored to customer needs. Its CMF (Color, Material, Finish) innovation center leads market trends, providing high-performance, environmentally friendly, and multifunctional coatings that enhance product aesthetics, durability, and functionality. The company’s strong customer relationships and global service network further reinforce its competitive edge.
